parsed.rationale: CSV export button on the invoice page started returning a 500 error as of this morning; affects only invoice exports (not customer exports). Finance needs it fixed before Friday close, indicating a critical workflow impact, and a 500 error requires engineering investigation.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi team—thanks for reporting this. We understand that starting this morning the CSV export button on the invoice page is returning an HTTP 500 error and blocks finance from exporting invoices (customer exports are not affected), though you do have a manual workaround for now.

We’re escalating this for engineering review and will investigate the invoice-page export flow to restore the expected behavior. To help us narrow it down quickly, could you share the following?
1) The environment where it fails (e.g., production) and whether it’s consistent or intermittent
2) The exact 500 error details you’re seeing (response message/body if available) or any request/correlation ID from the failed attempt
3) Steps to reproduce (e.g., export from which date range/all invoices or a specific invoice), and whether the failure happens for all users or only certain ones
4) Any recent deployment/config changes that occurred before the issue started

If you’re able to capture it, a browser/network log for one failed click (including the endpoint/URL and request parameters) would be especially helpful. 

In the meantime, we’ll continue to monitor the workaround you mentioned so finance can keep operating until the export flow is corrected.
